extension.description: Reviews apex commands that can overwrite files during compression, decompression, or archive repair.
extension.name: apex command protection

permissions.description: Reviews apex compress commands that can overwrite existing files or archives.
permissions.label: apex compression review
safer_guidance: Confirm the destination path is not an existing critical file.

permissions.description: Reviews apex decompress and extract commands that can overwrite existing destination files.
permissions.label: apex decompression review
safer_guidance: Check the destination directory before extracting to prevent accidental overwrite.

permissions.description: Reviews apex repair commands that can modify or overwrite existing archive files.
permissions.label: apex repair review
safer_guidance: Backup the archive before attempting repair in case corruption worsens.

rules.description: Identifies `apex compress` commands, which can overwrite existing files or archives. Invocations carrying unresolved shell expansions in the action position are reviewed because they cannot prove mutating actions absent.
safer_alternatives: Confirm the destination path is not an existing critical file.
rules.title: apex file compression

rules.description: Identifies `apex decompress` commands, which can extract files and potentially overwrite existing contents in the destination directory. Invocations carrying unresolved shell expansions in the action position are reviewed because they cannot prove mutating actions absent.
safer_alternatives: Confirm the destination directory is safe for extraction.
rules.title: apex archive decompression

rules.description: Identifies `apex repair` commands, which can modify or overwrite existing archives during the repair process. Invocations carrying unresolved shell expansions in the action position are reviewed because they cannot prove mutating actions absent.
safer_alternatives: Ensure you have a backup of the archive before repairing.
rules.title: apex archive repair

safer_alternatives: Check destinations before compressing or decompressing.
Backup archives before attempting to repair them.
